_readme: Installed plugins and where they come from. Update 'installed' after every plugin update.
keep: files inside the plugin folder (or elsewhere) that hold settings and must survive an update.
CounterStrikeSharp and Metamod are not listed: the KitsuneLab egg updates them on every start.
patched: plugin is self-built with local changes, read build/patches/README.md before updating it.

plugins.name: CS2-SimpleAdmin (+ FunCommands, StealthModule)
keep: StealthModule is in plugins/disabled (both custom_files and game/csgo): its player list kept stale controllers after map changes and very likely crashed the server (2026-10-31). Do not re-enable it when updating.

plugins.name: InventorySimulator
keep: gamedata/inventory-simulator.json (comes with the plugin, replace it too)

plugins.name: CustomCommands
keep: plugins/CustomCommands/Commands.json (all custom commands and the !help pages)

plugins.name: GameModeManager (self-built)
keep: never copy shared/ DLLs into the plugin folder

plugins.name: MenuManagerAPI (self-built)
keep: copy only MenuManagerAPI.dll/.pdb, never shared/ or PlayerSettings from bin/

plugins.name: Deathmatch
keep: configs/plugins/Deathmatch/Deathmatch.json: Hud Type 0, Game Length 10, Force Map End true

plugins.name: GunGame (GG2)
keep: cfg/gungame/gungame.json: EndGameSilent false, EndGameDelay 10, WinnerMessage 1 (no map chooser plugin, GameModeManager changes the map)

plugins.name: Advertisement (!rtv reminder)
keep: cfg/modes/*.cfg: unloaded in unload_plugins.cfg, loaded again in RTV modes (freeplay, deathmatch, gungame, awp, aim)

plugins.name: Cheats Guard (our own)
keep: used by cfg/settings/enable_*.cfg and disable_*.cfg (cheats_push / cheats_pop)

plugins.name: Move Debug (our own)
keep: !movedebug (root): movement state, game state (freeze/pause/warmup) to chat, movement cvars to the console

plugins.name: Retakes (Retake mode core, self-built)
keep: release zip with map configs: plugins/disabled/RetakesPlugin/map_config/*.json (11 maps) and shared/RetakesPluginShared
cfg/cs2-retakes/retakes.cfg (ours, no mp_match_end_restart: map_voting.cfg owns it) and retakes_unload.cfg (ours, no bot_quota 10)

plugins.name: Retakes Weapon Allocator (!guns, votes)
keep: delete RetakesPluginShared.dll and CounterStrikeSharp.API.dll from the release folder (shared/ and CSS provide them)
plugins/disabled/RetakesAllocator/weapons.db (SQLite, player loadouts, created on the server only)
needs MultiAddonManager + workshop addon 3792297574 (HUD layout); a new release may need the addon updated too

plugins.name: MultiAddonManager (Metamod)
keep: steamrt3 build (needs only GLIBC 2.14, works on both runtimes); addons/metamod/multiaddonmanager.vdf

plugins.name: All Maps (our own)
keep: !maps2 / !allmaps (@css/changemap): categories = map groups from gamemodes_server.txt, map change via GameModeManager css_map
!modes2 / !allmodes: exec the mode cfg + reload the current map (needs GameModeManager.Shared game_mode:api)
configs/plugins/AllMaps/AllMaps.json: Permission, Categories (Wingman maps = mg_valve_wingman, separate from Valve maps)

plugins.name: Grenade Rebuy (our own)
keep: on grenade_thrown lowers m_weaponPurchasesThisRound count of that grenade by 1
